from itertools import product
# regions over N,S,C,R: each of 16 regions empty(0)/nonempty(1)
sets='NSCR'
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
def cnt(model,f): return any(model[i] for i,r in enumerate(regs) if f(dict(zip(sets,r))))
res={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
for model in product([0,1],repeat=16):
    ok=(not cnt(model,lambda r:r['N'] and not r['S'])) and cnt(model,lambda r:r['S'] and r['C']) \
       and (not cnt(model,lambda r:r['C'] and r['R'])) and all(cnt(model,lambda r,x=x:r[x]) for x in sets)
    if not ok: continue
    if cnt(model,lambda r:r['S'] and r['R']): res['I']=False
    if cnt(model,lambda r:r['R'] and r['C']): res['II']=False
    if not cnt(model,lambda r:r['S'] and r['N']): res['III']=False
follow={k for k,v in res.items() if v}
opts={'A':{'I','III'},'B':{'II','III'},'C':{'I','II','III'},'D':{'III'}}
good=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]
assert good==['B']
steps: All necklaces are squares; some squares are circles; no circle is a ring
I (No square is a ring) is not certain: rings may overlap squares outside circles
II (No ring is a circle) is the converse of 'No circle is a ring' - follows
III (Some squares are necklaces) follows from All necklaces are squares (necklaces exist)

verifications.check_code:
import itertools
# regions of Venn: subsets of {N,S,C,R}; sets nonempty
names='NSCR'
regions=list(range(16))
def mem(r,x): return (r>>names.index(x))&1
import random
def holds(pop):
    have=lambda f:any(f(r) for r in pop)
    allf=lambda a,b:all((not mem(r,a)) or mem(r,b) for r in pop)
    def some(a,b): return have(lambda r:mem(r,a) and mem(r,b))
    def no(a,b): return not some(a,b)
    if not(allf('N','S') and some('S','C') and no('C','R')): return None
    if not all(any(mem(r,x) for r in pop) for x in names): return None
    return (no('S','R'),no('R','C'),some('S','N'))
res=[]
for mask in range(1,1<<16):
    pop=[r for r in range(16) if mask>>r&1]
    h=holds(pop)
    if h: res.append(h)
follow=tuple(all(h[i] for h in res) for i in range(3))
assert follow==(False,True,True)
opts={'A':(True,False,True),'B':(False,True,True),'C':(True,True,True),'D':(False,False,True)}
r=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]
assert r==['B']
steps: I fails: some squares may be rings (not circles)
II follows from No circle is ring
III follows: All necklaces are squares so some squares are necklaces
